text: Recently, the £200m project linking the M6 at Laney Green, Staffordshire, to the M54 at Featherstone, close to Wolverhampton, was confirmed by the government.
Recently, the government confirmed a £200 million project that will connect the M6 at Laney Green in Staffordshire to the M54 at Featherstone, close to Wolverhampton.
A plan to build an improved link between the M54 and M6 motorways is among more than 50 transport schemes to receive government support.
There is currently no direct motorway link allowing drivers using the M54 to get onto the northbound carriage of the M6, meaning they must use roads such as the A460.
At present, drivers on the M54 cannot directly access the northbound lane of the M6 via a motorway link, which forces them to rely on alternative roads like the A460.
